stemMd: Which category has the highest completeness rate?

options.label: C
options.textMd: All categories have the same rate

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Micro: 56/80=70%; Small: 96/120=80%; Medium: 150/200=75%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 80%.

distractorRationale.a: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 70%, 80%, 75%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.b: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 70%, 80%, 75%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.c: The ratios differ; equal rates cannot be inferred from the raw totals.
